title: Charlton Aria Vote Extends Korea Quantum Computing's Deadline
excerpt: Shareholders approve an extension for KQC Quantum, Inc.’s business combination with Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation, extending the deadline to finalize the Korea Quantum Computing deal.
content:
Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation shareholders have voted to extend the deadline for its business combination with Korea Quantum Computing through October 25, 2027. The approval, reached at a special meeting on October 19, 2026, allows for up to twelve successive one-month extensions to finalize the deal. This provides additional time to complete the previously announced proposed business combination, which aims to help enterprises adopt quantum computing and quantum-safe security. Additional details regarding the vote are available in Charlton Aria’s Form 8-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Charlton Aria Vote Extends Combination Deadline to October 25, 2027

KQC Parent, the Delaware-based parent company of Korea Quantum Computing Co., Ltd., aims to facilitate enterprise adoption of quantum computing and quantum-safe security solutions. The amendments approved by shareholders allow for a phased approach to finalizing the business combination, contingent on standard closing requirements. These include securing necessary regulatory approvals and further shareholder consent, as the proposed transaction remains subject to these conditions. KQC focuses on assisting organizations in integrating quantum technologies, a field gaining prominence in data security and computational power. Details are available in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
